title: The Lava Ferry
text: A ferryman poles a stone boat across a river of fire, the heat bending the air around him, his robes smoking. He does not burn. His fare is a memory, he says, one per passenger, and he holds out a hand that has taken a great many.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to pay the ferryman a memory for the crossing.

outcomes.text: He takes a small one; it is gone before they can miss it.
He takes a big one, smiling as he does.

options.label: Each Scion decides whether to find another way across, and keep their memories.

outcomes.text: They find a way around the river, singed and choking.
Their way leads through the fire.
